{{Top|leg}}
A '''shire''' was a common hooved beast of burden used on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] at the time of the [[Je'daii Order]]. A particular small species of shire, thinner than those found elsewhere on Tython, made its home in the [[Silent Desert]], where the water humps it bore on its back and neck aided in its survival. The mythological [[Solocorn]] resembled a winged shire.
